data.title: SYNCERE introduces LUME during New York Fashion Week
data.description: A new innovative product called LUME is being launched by SYNCERE in New York, representing a lamp that doubles as a household chore assistant. This device autonomously performs daily tasks like folding laundry and making the bed, all while also functioning as an aesthetically pleasing source of light in the home. SYNCERE will be unveiling LUME during New York Fashion Week, where it will be actively assisting backstage at the Altuzarra and Advsry shows. This integration showcases the intersection of fashion, home decor, design, and technology.

data.title: QIVIKA to Launch Smart Scope on Kickstarter, Bringing a Professional Long-Range Experience to Day-and-Night Exploration
data.description: Today, QIVIKA, a consumer technology firm specializing in smartphone-based optical imaging solutions, revealed that the QIVIKA Smart Scope will debut on Kickstarter on September 15, 2026. The device offers a portable optical system that has been carefully crafted for user convenience. It combines cutting-edge technology with practicality, catering to the needs of modern consumers. This launch marks a significant step for the company as it aims to make innovative optical imaging accessible to a broader audience.

data.title: WAFD SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Ademi LLP Investigates Whether Buyout Fairly Values WaFd, Inc.
data.description: Ademi LLP is currently conducting an investigation into the proposed merger agreement that will result in WaFd shareholders owning approximately 40.825% of the combined company. The firm is analyzing various aspects of the deal, such as the deal price, advantages for company insiders, and any limitations on competitive bids. The investigation is aimed at understanding the implications and potential concerns surrounding the merger. The details of this investigation were announced on September 11, 2026, in Milwaukee.

data.title: Computer Modelling Group Announces Annual General Meeting Voting Results
data.description: In Calgary, Alberta, on September 11, 2026, Computer Modelling Group Ltd. disclosed the outcomes of its annual general shareholder meeting held on September 10, 2026. With a total of 52,937,297 votes present either in person or through proxy, this amounted to around 67.87% of the company's entire issued and outstanding common shares as of the record date.

data.title: LHC Group Data Breach: Edelson Lechtzin LLP Launches Investigation Into Exposure of Personal Information
data.description: A prominent national class action law firm, Edelson Lechtzin LLP, is providing complimentary case assessments for individuals affected by the recent cybersecurity breach involving the LHC Group. Based in Lafayette, Louisiana, the firm is focusing on data privacy claims following the incident that occurred on September 11, 2026. The evaluation offer aims to assist those impacted by providing them with legal guidance and support. The investigation into this matter involves significant numbers of individuals who may have been affected by the breach.

data.title: IDScan.net Data Breach: Edelson Lechtzin LLP Launches Investigation Into Exposure of Personal Information
data.description: A renowned national class action legal firm, Edelson Lechtzin LLP, is providing complimentary case assessments for individuals affected by the recent cybersecurity breach at IDScan.net. This incident, which occurred in New Orleans on September 11, 2026, has sparked concerns about data privacy. The firm aims to assist those impacted by this breach through their investigation into potential claims related to the security issue.

data.title: FCPT Declares Fourth Quarter 2026 Monthly Dividends
data.description: A real estate investment trust, Four Corners Property Trust, Inc. (NYSE: FCPT), based in Mill Valley, California, declared monthly cash dividends of $0.1265 per share ($1.5180 per share annually) for the fourth quarter of 2026. The dividends will be payable in cash to common stock shareholders of record as of the record date. This marks a 3.5% increase from the previous quarter. The payment dates are outlined in a table provided by the company's Board of Directors.

data.title: /C O R R E C T I O N -- Jollibee/
data.description: Jollibee has announced a new partnership with DreamWorks Animation's latest original film, Forgotten Island, on 08-Sep-2026. The collaboration aims to celebrate friendship and Filipino culture in an exclusive venture. The news comes as part of a press release shared by Jollibee, showcasing their commitment to showcasing cultural values through unique collaborations. This partnership marks a significant move for both companies, with plans to reach a large audience and promote the essence of camaraderie and Filipino heritage. Jollibee's association with DreamWorks Animation's latest project underscores their dedication to fostering meaningful connections and promoting cultural diversity. This joint effort is expected to resonate with a broad audience, highlighting the essence of friendship and the richness of Filipino traditions.
